journeyNote.gapTitle: {dimension} is where your next effort counts most.
journeyNote.gapBodyWithAwaiting: Of the {assessed, plural, one {# area} other {# areas}} Oryn can currently assess, this one has the least behind it — so the same hours move your profile furthest here. {awaitingEvidence, plural, one {# other area has} other {# other areas have}} nothing recorded yet, so this reading may change as you add more.
journeyNote.gapBodySimple: Of everything Oryn can assess, this area has the least behind it — which makes it where the same hours move your profile furthest.
journeyNote.strengthBody: It's the best-evidenced part of your record. Adding more of the same is unlikely to change how your profile reads — the leverage is elsewhere.
